name: Tubes bonded below absorber plate
model_note: Bond resistance = adhesive thickness / (ka * tube OD) between plate and tube (legacy F-prime relation)

name: Tubes bonded above absorber plate
model_note: Strip under the tube exchanges heat at tube-wall temperature; bond resistance only on the fin path (legacy F-prime relation)

name: Tubes in-line with absorber plate
model_note: Tube is part of the plate; no bond resistance (legacy F-prime relation)
